points.description: States that an SVM is a linear classifier/learning machine that separates classes with a decision boundary (hyperplane) chosen to have maximum margin.
points.partial_credit: Half credit if only decision boundary/hyperplane is mentioned without maximum margin (or vice versa).

points.description: States that the data points closest to the decision boundary are called support vectors and that they determine the margin/boundary.
points.partial_credit: Half credit if support vectors are named but their role in determining the margin is not stated.

points.description: Mentions kernels (kernel trick) for handling non-linearly separable data, and/or that training is solved as a quadratic programming (optimisation) problem. Equivalent wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: Half credit if only one of kernels or quadratic programming is given.
